title: Penalized Maximum Likelihood Inference of Core-Periphery Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.15796v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Likelihood-based network models are often fitted under links' independence and low-order constraints, while empirical networks frequently exhibit systematic higher-order structures such as triangles and wedges, characterizing the observed clustering patterns. Real-world core-periphery networks such as the interbank market or the air transportation system represent key examples, with cores displaying complex and nonlinear features. We formalize Penalized Likelihood with Structural Discrepancies (PLSD) as an inference-level correction that trades likelihood fit for agreement with targeted motifs. PLSD augments the negative log-likelihood with a penalty on standardized wedge and triangle discrepancies, yielding a controlled distortion of the likelihood surface that can be interpreted through a linear response analysis. translated_title: 核-边缘网络的惩罚极大似然推断
translated_abstract: 基于似然的网络模型通常在链接独立性和低阶约束下进行拟合，而经验网络经常表现出系统性的高阶结构，如三角形和楔形，这些结构刻画了所观测到的聚类模式。现实世界中的核-边缘网络（如银行间市场或航空运输系统）是典型的例子，其核心部分展现出复杂和非线性的特征。我们将带结构差异惩罚的似然（PLSD）形式化为一种推断层面的修正方法，该方法以似然拟合度换取与目标模体的一致性。PLSD在负对数似然基础上增加了对标准化楔形和三角形差异的惩罚，从而对似然面产生可控的扭曲，这一扭曲可以通过线性响应分析来解释。此外，本文还针对该模型唯一的调节超参数引入了一种校准方法，以便在……时关闭惩罚项。（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了带结构差异惩罚的似然方法（PLSD），通过在负对数似然中加入对楔形和三角形等高阶结构差异的惩罚项，实现对核-边缘网络等具有复杂聚类结构的现实网络更准确的统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Penalized Likelihood with Structural Discrepancies (PLSD), an inference-level correction that augments the negative log-likelihood with penalties on standardized wedge and triangle discrepancies, enabling more accurate inference for real-world core-periphery networks with complex clustering structures.
